lines.text: In 1957, British TV convinced viewers that spaghetti grows on trees.

lines.text: April 1st. A serious British TV show aired a report from Switzerland.

lines.text: A Swiss family... harvesting spaghetti, straight off the trees.

lines.text: The report even said the dreaded spaghetti weevil had virtually disappeared.

lines.text: It was an April Fools' joke, of course.
